chapter.heading: 2 Corinthians 9
The Collection for Christians in Jerusalem
chapter.v: Nowit is superfluous for me to write to you aboutthe ministry for the saints ,
for I know your readiness ,of which I boast about you to the people of Macedonia , saying that Achaia has been readysince last year . And your zeal has stirred up most of them .
ButI am sending the brothers so that our boasting about you may not prove empty in this matter , so that you may be ready ,as I said you would be .
Otherwise , if some Macedonianscome with me and find that you are not ready , we would be humiliated — to say nothing of you — for being so confident .
So I thought it necessary to urge the brothers to go on ahead to you and arrange in advance for thegift you have promised , so that it may be readyas a willing gift ,not as an exaction .
The point is this :whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly , and whoever sows bountifully will also reap bountifully .
Each one must give as he has decided in his heart ,not reluctantly or under compulsion , forGod loves a cheerful giver .
AndGod is able to make all grace abound to you , so that having all sufficiency in all things at all times , you may abound in every good work .
He who suppliesseed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your seed for sowing andincrease the harvest of your righteousness .
You will be enriched in every way to be generous in every way , whichthrough us will produce thanksgiving to God .
For the ministry of this service is not only supplyingthe needs of the saints but is also overflowing in many thanksgivings to God .

By their approval of this service ,they will glorify God because of your submission that comes from yourconfession of the gospel of Christ , and the generosity of your contribution for them and for all others ,
while they long for you and pray for you , because of the surpassing grace of God upon you .
Thanks be to God for his inexpressible gift !
